workflow: Built-in ImageGen redesign: one focal emblem, quiet color-field background, simple complete border, project card-art style

items.name: 行囊粗布
items.imagegen_prompt: Create ONE new simplified fantasy playing-card BACK artwork, portrait 2:3, flat front-on, full bleed. All supplied images are our PROJECT'S ACTUAL CARD ART STYLE references only: use their low-detail hand-painted anime finish, large connected opaque color planes, a few confident wide strokes, hard grouped shadows and selective restrained midtones. Do not copy their swords, slash beams, chest, pose or composition. The previous card-back designs were too crowded; this version must have ONE focal emblem and large calm negative space. Simplicity is about FEWER OBJECTS and a cleaner composition, not adding texture to a complicated layout. Card theme: 行囊粗布. ONE large folded ochre cloth knot at the center, with two broad cloth ends and one simple dark tie. Just a few principal fold planes, no fabric pattern or rope winding around the picture. Warm sand/umber against quiet blue-grey. COMPOSITION: one centered oversized readable emblem, about 55-65% of canvas width, surrounded by generous quiet space. Background is only two or three broad subdued painted color fields, nearly unpatterned. Add one SIMPLE CLOSED rectangular border on all four sides: a single dark slate band with a restrained muted-gold inner edge, uniform visual weight, no corner plates, jewels, layered frames, bolts, notches, vertical reinforcing strips or extra decoration. The border remains complete and clearly visible but secondary to the main symbol. Complete clear silhouettes, very economical interiors, matte opaque paint, a few wide directional stroke endings and broad light/shadow planes. Avoid tiny marks, fine material patterns, fine scales, dense engraving, ornamental swirls, speckled grain, all-over brush flakes, photorealism, glossy 3D and vector-perfect flat filling. No text, letters, numbers, logos, UI, table, card mockup or margins outside the artwork.
